digest.component_or_area: check_raw_git_writes.py static linter; reconciler atomic-transaction enforcement
key_entities: mutation primitives: add, commit, commit_tree, read_tree, rm_cached, update_ref, write_tree
propositions: The existing static lint gate (d37e policy, R1/R2 rules) enforces mechanism (no raw subprocess git) but not protocol (mutations via atomic transaction), allowing out-of-transaction git_adapter primitive composition to pass undetected.

Rule R3 (seam-composition) must fire when a git-adapter mutation primitive is called from outside the three sanctioned write-seam files (git_adapter.py, _ref_lock.py, _ref_lock_push.py), resolved via import or dynamic-loader bindings per file.

Two out-of-transaction sites require durable reasoned inline markers after parallel remediations land: reconcile_helpers.py selective 5-file staging boundary, and __main__.py detached-index CAS ref-advance concurrency design.
The static rule must not fire on non-git-adapter .add/.commit calls (set, session) or read-only exports (commit_email), verified by false-positive floor test across src/ and scripts/.
Module-size extraction of _pass_lock_lifecycle.py from __main__.py (pass-lock lifecycle cluster) reduces __main__.py below complexity gate and preserves patch target names via re-export.
R3's first real-tree run enumerates exactly 7 hits across 2 functions with zero false positives, both sites sanctioned with durable reasoned markers, gate lands clean with no debt baseline.
